Name: Sprinkler Upgrades
Author: kkocgo
Description:
描述
新增两条洒水器合成升级配方，让你可以用低级洒水器升级成高级洒水器，同时完全保留原版合成路径。低等级洒水器不再浪费，可以一路升级到铱制。
安装方法
[list=1]
[*]确保已安装 SMAPI 和 Content Patcher。[/*]
[*]下载本 Mod 并解压。[/*]
[*]将 [CP] Sprinkler Upgrades 整个文件夹放入游戏目录下的 Mods 文件夹。[/*]
[*]进入游戏，当耕种等级达到要求后，合成菜单里就会出现新配方。[/*]
[/list]主要功能
[list]
[*][b]基础洒水器 → 优质洒水器[/b]
材料： 基础洒水器 ×1 + 金锭 ×1 + 精炼石英  ×1
解锁条件：耕种等级 6（与原版优质洒水器同时解锁）[/*]
[*][b]优质洒水器 → 铱洒水器[/b]
材料：优质洒水器 ×1 + 铱锭 ×1 + 电池组 ×1
解锁条件：耕种等级 9（与原版铱洒水器同时解锁）[/*]
[*][b]优质洒水器 → 铱洒水器[/b]
材料： 基础洒水器 ×1 + 金锭 ×1 + 精炼石英  ×1 + 铱锭 ×1 + 电池组 ×1
解锁条件：耕种等级 9（与原版铱洒水器同时解锁） [/*]
[*]原有的直接合成配方（用金属锭合成）完全保留，新旧路径互不冲突，你可以自由选择。[/*]
[/list]前置需求
[list]
[*]SMAPI（建议最新版）[/*]
[*]Content Patcher（建议最新版）[/*]
[/list]鸣谢
感谢星露谷物语 mod 社区，感谢 Content Patcher 作者 Pathoschild。感谢所有希望把旧洒水器变废为宝的玩家们带来的灵感。

[heading]Description[/heading]
Adds three new upgrade crafting recipes for sprinklers, allowing you to turn lower-tier sprinklers into higher-tier ones while keeping the original recipes. No more throwing away old basic sprinklers – now you can upgrade them all the way to iridium.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip the folder.[/*]
[*]Place the entire [CP] Sprinkler Upgradesfolder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game. The new recipes will appear in the crafting menu once you reach the required farming levels.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Basic Sprinkler → Quality Sprinkler[/b]
Materials: 1 Basic Sprinkler + 1 Gold Bar + 1 Refined Quartz
Unlocked at Farming level 6 (same as the original Quality Sprinkler recipe).[/*]
[*][b]Quality Sprinkler → Iridium Sprinkler (upgrade path 1)[/b]
Materials: 1 Quality Sprinkler + 1 Iridium Bar + 1 Battery Pack
Unlocked at Farming level 9 (same as the original Iridium Sprinkler recipe).[/*]
[*][b]Basic Sprinkler → Iridium Sprinkler (upgrade path 2, direct cross-grade)[/b]
Materials: 1 Basic Sprinkler + 1 Gold Bar + 1 Refined Quartz + 1 Iridium Bar + 1 Battery Pack
Unlocked at Farming level 9. This lets you skip the quality sprinkler step entirely if you have enough resources.[/*]
[*]All original crafting recipes for sprinklers remain unchanged and work alongside these new ones. You can always choose the crafting path that suits your materials.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]SMAPI (latest version recommended)[/*]
[*]Content Patcher (latest version recommended)[/*]
[/list][heading]Shout outs[/heading]
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and Pathoschild for Content Patcher. Inspired by everyone who wanted to put their old sprinklers to better use.
